mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as rising demand anticipates corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in UNRATE above 0.1 percentage points in a month triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to heightened labor market uncertainty.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE rises >0.1pp, the 20d returns are not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in HOUST signals accommodative monetary policy and increased demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases while HOUST increases in the same month
failure_condition: The interaction of FEDFUNDS decline and HOUST rise does not predict positive returns in >60% of instances where the proxies meet the trigger condition.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a sudden drop in FEDFUNDS below 4.0% predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as investors anticipate policy easing.
failure_condition: During a tightening cycle, FEDFUNDS drops below 4.0% but 20d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO exceeds 110 in the current month, it predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as strong supply growth signals economic resilience.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO exceeds 110 in the current month
failure_condition: INDPRO exceeding 110 in a month does not lead to significantly higher 60d returns than baseline in 3 out of 4 such occurrences.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in FEDFUNDS and rise in GDPC1 indicates accommodative monetary policy and growing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS decreases while GDPC1 increases in the same month
failure_condition: The combined effect of FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise does not predict positive returns in >70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in UNRATE predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as lower unemployment reduces risk premiums.
failure_condition: A sustained UNRATE decline does not consistently correlate with positive 60d returns (p >0.05 in 3-year walk-forward).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a rise in GDPC1 by more than 5% in the current month predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as immediate growth expectations surge.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, GDPC1 rises >5% monthly but 5d returns are not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) in >50% of cases.
